newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Petronas raises 38 bln yen in Samurai bonds.
newsitem.headline: Petronas raises 38 bln yen in Samurai bonds.

text.p: Malaysian state-owned oil and gas company Petroliam Nasional Bhd (Petronas) said on Friday it had issued 38 billion yen worth of Samurai bonds on the Japanese capital markets.
"A subscription agreement on the latest bond issue was signed today in Tokyo between Petronas and the lead manager (Daiwa Securities Co Ltd )," Petronas said.
The bonds, launched on February 28, were issued in three tranches, two of 11 billion yen and one of 16 billion yen, said Petronas.
The maturity periods of the three tranches are six, 10 and 16.5 years.
The coupon rates of each tranche are 2.15 percent, 2.9 percent and 3.4 percent respectively.
"The proceeds arising from the bond issue would be used to refinance existing Petronas' yen borrowings," Petronas said.
